title: Why Nike and Lululemon are struggling: 'A lot of surface area to defend'
title_zh: 为什么耐克和 Lululemon 举步维艰：“有很多区域需要防守”
summary: Shares in Nike and Lululemon have declined as the two athletic-wear retailers have struggled to find their footing.
summary_zh: 耐克和露露柠檬的股价下跌，因为这两家运动服装零售商一直在努力寻找立足点。

title: Apple event live updates: Foldable iPhone and watches expected
title_zh: 苹果活动实时更新：预计可折叠 iPhone 和手表
summary: Apple is hosting its annual fall event at its Cupertino, Calif., headquarters.
summary_zh: 苹果公司正在其加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺总部举办年度秋季活动。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip as oil prices hit $100
title_zh: 今日股市：油价触及 100 美元，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: Stocks were under pressure as oil prices continued their journey upward and traders shifted their expectations of a Fed rate hike in September.
summary_zh: 由于油价继续上涨，且交易员改变了对美联储 9 月加息的预期，股市承压。

title: Google to invest $15 billion AI infrastructure in Finland
title_zh: 谷歌将在芬兰投资 150 亿美元人工智能基础设施
summary: HELSINKI, Sept 9 (Reuters) - Alphabet's Google will invest at least €13 billion ($15.1 billion) in artificial intelligence infrastructure in Finland over the next two years, it said on Wednesday,
summary_zh: 赫尔辛基，9 月 9 日（路透社） - Alphabet 旗下的谷歌周三表示，未来两年将在芬兰的人工智能基础设施上投资至少 130 亿欧元（151 亿美元）。

title: Qualcomm and Amazon ink deal for custom data center chips
title_zh: 高通和亚马逊签署定制数据中心芯片协议
summary: Qualcomm has signed a custom data center chip deal with Amazon.
summary_zh: 高通已与亚马逊签署了定制数据中心芯片协议。

title: How Apple stock usually reacts to big iPhone reveal events
title_zh: 苹果股票通常如何应对重大 iPhone 泄露事件

title: What investors 'really' need to see from Oracle earnings this week
title_zh: 投资者“真正”需要从甲骨文本周的财报中看到什么
summary: Oracle (ORCL) is reporting quarterly earnings results on Thursday. Bloomberg Intelligence senior technology credit analyst Robert Schiffman shares what investors should be keeping an eye on in the earnings print, especially from a debt-issuance perspective.
summary_zh: 甲骨文（ORCL）将于周四公布季度收益结果。彭博资讯高级科技信贷分析师罗伯特·希夫曼分享了投资者在财报中应关注的内容，尤其是从债务发行的角度来看。

title: Bond yield worries persist as oil edges higher: AlphaCheck
title_zh: 随着油价上涨，债券收益率担忧持续存在：AlphaCheck
summary: Stocks fell on Monday as long-dated bond yields continued to climb amid surging oil prices, raising concerns that the Federal Reserve will need to hike rates at its policy meeting next week.
summary_zh: 周一股市下跌，因长期债券收益率在油价飙升的情况下继续攀升，引发人们对美联储将需要在下周政策会议上加息的担忧。
